<!-- Source page: Cert Spotter -->

[Cert Spotter](https://github.com/SSLMate/certspotter) is a tool for monitoring Certificate Transparency logs.

It is documented in the [NixOS manual](https://nixos.org/manual/nixos/stable/#module-services-certspotter).
